remarks:
It's all about the VIEWS! Welcome to 2418 Little Bone Run Road, where breathtaking countryside views take center stage! Situated on 3.9 acres in Kennedy, NY, this charming 3 bedroom, 1 bath home offers a picturesque setting with sweeping views of the surrounding rolling hills and countryside. The sellers have thoughtfully removed numerous trees to open up the landscape and showcase the stunning scenery. Whether you're enjoying your morning coffee or unwinding at sunset, the views are truly something special!

Two covered porches provide wonderful spaces to relax, entertain, and take in the peaceful surroundings. The property also features a small pond, a 2-car garage, a spacious garden shed, and plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors.

Inside, you'll find a home filled with updates! Improvements include a new furnace (2022), updated kitchen flooring, appliances and fixtures, a completely remodeled bathroom, new bedroom carpeting, fresh paint, select replacement windows, a new hot water tank, sidewalk, and soffits. Additional features include central air conditioning, a blacktop driveway, generator panel connection, and a partially finished walkout basement offering flexible additional living space.

Located in Cattaraugus County within the Randolph Central School District and just minutes from Chautauqua County, this property combines beautiful scenery, acreage, and modern updates in one inviting package.
